bullet: DELETE on an unknown id (`F04.delete-unknown-id`), known bug.
script:
control-agent-server api GET /openapi.json --check 'paths.<redacted:session-cookie>/{conversation_id}.delete.responses.404' exists --quiet
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$DEL" --expect 404
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOPE" --expect 404
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOPE" --expect 404 --save F04.delete-unknown-id/unknown  # bug
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$DEL" --expect 404 --save F04.delete-unknown-id/repeat  # bug
